description: Reported financial results (财报 / 业绩报表) for a Chinese A-share company by stock code and report period: total operating revenue (营业总收入), net profit attributable to parent (归母净利润), their year-over-year growth, gross margin (销售毛利率), EPS, weighted ROE, book value per share and operating cash flow per share, plus the balance-sheet debt-to-asset ratio (资产负债率), total assets and total liabilities for the same period. Answers '九阳股份 002242 三季报 营收 净利润', '600519 2026半年报 归母净利润', 'reported revenue and net profit for 000988', '资产负债率', 'A-share quarterly results by period'. Give `period` as the report-period end date (2026-03-31 Q1, 2026-06-30 half-year, 2026-09-30 Q3, 2026-12-31 annual) for one report, or omit it for the latest `limit` reports, newest first. Amounts in CNY; growth, margin, ROE and debt ratio in percent. These are the figures as filed, not analyst estimates (see ashares_analyst_consensus) or company guidance (see ashares_earnings_forecast). Source: Eastmoney datacenter, listed-company periodic reports (keyless).

limit.description: When no period is given, how many reports to return, 1-12 (default 4, newest first).

period.description: Report period end date, YYYY-MM-DD: 03-31, 06-30, 09-30 or 12-31 (e.g. "2026-09-30"). Omit for the latest reports.

symbol.description: 6-digit A-share code, e.g. "002242" (九阳股份) or "600519" (贵州茅台).

name: ashares_financial_statements

found.description: False when no report exists for the code/period

debt_to_asset_ratio_pct.description: Total liabilities over total assets, percent; null when the balance sheet is not available

net_profit_attributable_cny.description: Net profit attributable to parent, year-to-date, CNY

net_profit_yoy_pct.description: Net profit growth vs same period last year, percent

operating_cash_flow_per_share_cny.description: Operating cash flow per share, CNY

report_type.description: Report label, e.g. 2026年 三季报

revenue_yoy_pct.description: Revenue growth vs same period last year, percent

title: Ashares Financial Statements
